استضعفن (form X)
# اِسْتَضْعَفْنَ (istaḍʕafna) /is.tadˤ.ʕaf.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَضْعَفَ (istaḍʕafa)
# اُسْتُضْعِفْنَ (ustuḍʕifna) /us.tudˤ.ʕif.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَضْعَفَ (istaḍʕafa)
# اِسْتَضْعِفْنَ (istaḍʕifna) /is.tadˤ.ʕif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَضْعَفَ (istaḍʕafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
